rules: Universal translator access does not guarantee perfect or instant translation.
Literal translation can preserve words while losing metaphor, pragmatics or intent.
Unknown languages may require observation and analysis before a usable matrix exists.
A character who knows the original language can notice translator errors when their knowledge permits.
Machine translation never grants cultural familiarity automatically.
AI output may present translated dialogue, partial translation or untranslated content only as Core language state allows.
Newly generated languages receive stable language_id and translation-matrix state.
First-contact dialogue cannot silently jump from analysis_required to confident translation without samples/cause.
